description: pyesios is the ESIOS project's Python client for accessing indicators published by the Spanish electricity-system operator. It contains functions to request indicator names and multiple time series, returning combined and individual tables for analysis. Users supply indicator identifiers, dates and their own provider API key. Coverage is the Spanish market and system series available through ESIOS, with temporal resolution determined by each indicator. Repository code is free under GPL-3.0 and can be installed from PyPI. A limitation is explicit in the README: requests from 2022 onward have problems and the package imposes a date limiter. Current service compatibility therefore remains uncertain. The client can prepare historical price and demand inputs for electricity simulations. PyPSA (model-pypsa) is a related modelling resource. The API was not called and the README's illustrative authentication values were excluded from saved evidence.
